scenario: A resident plans a courtyard storytelling circle and later chooses how people may participate.
memory_focus: Listening without telling a story is welcome.
detours: Discuss arranging chairs for conversation, then ways to help strangers feel comfortable.

scenario: A volunteer prepares to greet visitors at a neighbourhood plant exchange.
memory_focus: Visitors may take a plant without bringing one to exchange.
detours: Discuss keeping the entrance clear, then how volunteers can introduce themselves.

scenario: A community mural group works out how to include residents who cannot attend painting day.
memory_focus: Residents can contribute ideas without painting.
detours: Discuss choosing a broad theme, then how to gather differing views respectfully.

scenario: The user describes missing the beginning of a film they watched with a friend.
memory_focus: They arrived late because their bicycle chain came off on the way to the cinema.
detours: Discuss what they thought of the ending; then discuss whether they would watch the film again. Finally ask why they missed the opening.

scenario: A local history circle considers how to share memories of an old marketplace.
memory_focus: The user wants personal recollections presented as memories, not verified history.
detours: Discuss inviting different generations, then how to keep a group discussion moving.

scenario: A resident proposes a community singing session for people who feel shy.
memory_focus: Participants may hum instead of singing words.
detours: Discuss choosing familiar material, then how to begin without putting anyone on the spot.

scenario: A neighbourhood group plans to make a shared outdoor space more welcoming.
memory_focus: The existing shaded corner must remain open for quiet sitting.
detours: Discuss how to invite suggestions, then how to handle conflicting ideas.

scenario: Someone starts an informal circle where neighbours teach each other practical skills.
memory_focus: Each demonstration should be optional to try.
detours: Discuss choosing a first topic, then ways to welcome beginners.

scenario: A resident helps a community art group decide how to display unfinished work.
memory_focus: Artists choose whether their unfinished pieces are displayed.
detours: Discuss arranging a room for browsing, then how to respond to visitors' questions.

scenario: A neighbourhood cleanup organiser considers how people with different energy levels can participate.
memory_focus: Sorting collected litter is an alternative to walking the route.
detours: Discuss pairing new and experienced volunteers, then ending the activity on time.

scenario: A community dance gathering needs a welcoming first activity.
memory_focus: The user prefers a dance people can join without a partner.
detours: Discuss creating a relaxed atmosphere, then how to handle different experience levels.

scenario: A resident starts a neighbourhood conversation table for people new to the area.
memory_focus: Nobody is expected to share their address.
detours: Discuss open-ended conversation starters, then how to include a quiet participant.
